title: Google's Neural Machine Translation System
authors: Y. Wu, M. Schuster, Z. Chen, et al. (31 authors)
before: Neural translation worked in papers; production systems were still statistical.
problem: Research models were too slow and too brittle to serve at Google scale.
breakthrough: A deep LSTM encoder-decoder with attention, wordpiece tokenization and the engineering to deploy it.
why: The first time a neural sequence model replaced a mature statistical system in a product used by millions.
next: The Transformer, from the same organisation, made this architecture obsolete within a year.
inherits: WordPiece tokenization, and the proof that neural generation can ship.
